evals.prompt:
We're moving our Infrahub instance to 1.7 next week. The release notes
for 1.6.0 through 1.7.0 are in release-notes/, and source snapshots for each
release are in source/. Go through our skills under skills/ and update them
to the current way of doing things, so nobody copies something that no longer
works on 1.7.
evals.expected_output: A REPORT.md with one finding for skills/acme-querying-inventory/rules/filters.md, rated High, with evidence pinned to infrahub-v1.7.0 or a commit, and a recommended gate that names both 1.6 (name__contains available, name__like deprecated) and 1.7 (name__like removed) and leaves no release without working guidance: name__like up to at least 1.6, name__contains from 1.6. The skill files are left unchanged.
expectations: The finding cites infrahub-v1.6.0 for the deprecation and infrahub-v1.7.0 for the removal
The pre-release infrahub-v1.7.0b1 is not cited
The gate keeps `name__like` up to at least 1.6 and starts `name__contains` at 1.6, instead of replacing the old filter
The removal of INFRAHUB_LEGACY_CACHE is not reported as a finding, since no skill mentions it
The files under skills/ are not edited
